input.brief: Marci Metzger, a highly experienced Pahrump Realtor rooted in Mountain Falls

direction.name: Photographs at uneven sizes
direction.idea: A calm page where the pictures are placed like prints on a gallery wall: each at its own size and position, with text set small and light between them. Nothing lines up in the obvious way, yet everything sits on a grid you can feel. The unevenness is what makes it read as art-directed by a person: a small portrait far left, a wide landscape running off the right edge, a square that overlaps the next section. It lets photographs lead without ever becoming a slideshow.
direction.composition: A 12-column grid with wide margins (5–7vw). The hero is a single line of large light type (6–9vw) across the top third, and below it one photograph placed off-centre (columns 6–12, 16:10), its top edge overlapping the baseline zone of the headline by a few pixels of deliberate tension. Each following section places two or three photographs with different spans and vertical offsets: for example a 3:4 portrait in columns 2–5 starting 120px lower than a 16:10 landscape in columns 7–12; then a single small 1:1 in columns 9–11 beside a paragraph in columns 2–6. Paragraphs are short (max 40ch) and sit in the gaps. No two consecutive sections use the same arrangement. Vertical spacing is large and irregular on purpose (120–260px).
direction.typography: A light or regular weight at large size for the few headings; small, quiet text. Serif or a slender sans. Everything left-aligned to grid lines.
direction.colour: A pale neutral ground with one deep ink taken from the photographs. No accent beyond a quiet link colour.
direction.imagery: Six to nine photographs from one set, in a deliberate mix of ratios (3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 16:10, 21:9). Square corners. Captions, if any, are one short line under an image in the soft ink.
direction.richness: Placement. The differing sizes and offsets create movement on a still page.
direction.pitfalls: Uneven is not random: every image edge lands on a column line, and offsets come from a small set of values. On a phone, keep the unevenness with alternating widths (100%, 72% left, 60% right) rather than stacking everything full width.

hero.name: Two prints in darkness
hero.blueprint: One near-black field with a slight colour tint, about 75% of it left empty. Navigation is split between the top corners at 15px on 30px margins: the wordmark and three text links top-left, the single action top-right as the page's one solid light rectangle. Two low-key photographs sit in the dark like lit exhibits, both with square corners and no frame. The larger, a 4:5 portrait about 34% of the viewport wide (columns 6-9), has its top at 14% of the height, so it sits a little above the midline. The smaller, a 1:1 about 12% of the viewport wide (columns 2-3), sits far from it with its top at 52% of the height, dimmed with filter: brightness(0.7) so the large one stays the brightest thing on screen. The headline is modest: two lines at clamp(28px, 2.5vw, 40px) in a regular weight, flush to the bottom-left corner on the 30px margin. Columns 10-12 hold one sentence at 16px in the dimmer ink, bottom-aligned to the headline's last baseline, max 24ch. Nothing else is on screen.
hero.mobile: The large photograph takes 78% of the width, pushed to the right margin, its top at 12% of the height. The small square sits at 30% of the width on the left margin, overlapping the large one's lower-left corner by 24px. The headline sets at 6.4vw on two lines bottom-left with the sentence beneath at 15px. The action is a small solid rectangle top-right; links fold behind a menu word.
hero.headline: A quiet statement of 4-7 words at 28-40px, at most 44 characters on two lines.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Plain names in columns
sections.blueprint: A typographic list with no logos. The heading, two or three words at 28–32px, sits in columns 1–3 and stays top-aligned with the first row of names. Columns 5–12 hold the names in three or four text columns (`columns: 4; column-gap: 32px`), each name on its own line at 20–22px with leading 1.5, sentence case, in the full ink. Where names fall into kinds (clients, press, partners), each kind starts a new column and its first line names the kind in the softer ink at the same size, so no small labels are needed. Columns are of unequal length and are not balanced; ragged bottoms are intended. Twelve to thirty names work best. There are no boxes, bullets or separators: the column edges and the shared baseline do the organising. Leave 120px above and below.
sections.mobile: The heading leads at 26px. Names follow in two columns at 17px with a 20px gap; each kind begins after a 32px break with its name in the softer ink on the first line. Long names wrap inside their column rather than shrinking.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: One scene, stepping statements
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 350–450vh tall holds a sticky full-bleed photograph (100vw by 100svh) with a calm, symmetrical subject and a clear upper third; a neutral dark scrim covers only that upper third. At top centre, five or six short statements of two to five words are stacked at 18–20px with 10px between them; the first of them is the section's heading. One statement is at full white and the rest at 45% opacity; the active line steps down the stack as the reader scrolls (IntersectionObserver on invisible 70vh markers). For each statement, two small photographs with square corners, 160–240px wide and of different ratios, fade in left and right of the centre line at different heights, then leave when the next pair arrives. No other text. A low-key image on a deep ground works equally well.
sections.mobile: The photograph stays sticky at 100svh, cropped to its centre. The statement stack moves to the bottom third over a scrim, at 17px, left-aligned on the margin. Each statement brings one small photograph only, 44vw wide, placed in the top-right corner with a 16px margin.

sections.name: Photographs gathered round a heading
sections.blueprint: A band about one screen tall on the plain page ground, used as the page's one deliberate rest. At its visual centre sits the heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light weight, centred, with one sentence at 17px under it and a text link beneath that. Around it six to eight small photographs are scattered irregularly across the middle columns (x 320–1120; the outer 320px on each side stay empty, equally), each 160–200px wide at about 9:10, square corners, at different heights with 60–200px of air between them. Two of them come within 40px of the heading's block, which their drift never reaches, so the cluster reads as gathered round it rather than laid on a grid. No captions and no frames. Each photograph drifts at its own rate as the band passes (4–12% of its own height on a scroll-linked timeline), so the cluster loosens and tightens; under reduced motion it stays put. The pictures come from one place or one day and share one treatment.
sections.mobile: Five photographs at 30% of the width sit offset left and right around the centred heading, two above it and three below, none cut by an edge. The heading drops to 7vw on two lines.

sections.name: Pinned title, portraits pass
sections.blueprint: A wrapper tall enough for its portraits: about 90svh per person, up to six people. A `position: sticky; top: 0` layer of 100svh holds the heading, two words at clamp(88px, 12vw, 180px), leading 0.85, centred at mid-height, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` so it reads over ground and photographs alike. Beneath it in the stacking order, portraits scroll past in normal flow: each a 4:5 photograph 26–30vw wide, alternately starting at column 2 and ending at column 11, 60svh apart, so each one passes behind a different half of the heading. Under each portrait's left corner: the name at 18px, the role at 14px in the soft ink, and one sentence of up to 30 words in a 280px measure. The last portrait is followed by 40svh of empty ground before the heading releases. Square corners. Nothing else is on screen.
sections.mobile: The heading shrinks to 17vw and pins 16px from the top instead of at mid-height. Portraits become 72% wide, alternating between the left and right margins, 48px apart, each with name, role and sentence beneath at the portrait's width.

sections.name: Sentence, portrait, two links
sections.blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 12–18 words at clamp(26px, 3vw, 44px), four lines, leading 1.1, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
sections.mobile: The sentence comes first at 7.4vw. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Tengile Malamala Collection
references.idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
references.hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
references.type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
references.colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
references.imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
references.layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.
references.media: A 10s muted aerial montage covers the whole first screen with type set on it and no visible scrim. Below: a split with an image and paragraph in the right half from the centre line, staggered image pairs with uneven heights and offsets, a three-up card row with captions, an inset full-width slider, a constellation of thumbnails round a centred heading, a slow portrait marquee, and a sticky full-bleed landscape with the closing call scrolling over it; 33 images, pictures oversized about 110% in their masks for drift.
references.motion: There is no preloader and only the montage cuts after 400ms, but under Lenis content stays hidden until each reveal fires: blocks rise and sharpen from a blur over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), others fade with a filter over 1s cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1), pictures drift inside their masks, and the closing landscape holds on a sticky root. The ground steps from cream to sage-beige to olive, and the marquee loops on 120s.

references.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
references.idea: Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.
references.hero: A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.
references.type: Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.
references.imagery: Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.
references.layout: 24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.

sections.description: White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.

Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.

A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.

Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.

steal: Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.
Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.
Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.
references.media: One photoreal render covers the whole first screen with only the title docked bottom-left and no scrim. Below: a full-bleed 2:1 band under a centred headline, overscanned 32px per side for parallax, a staggered two-column scatter of landscape and portrait frames at uneven offsets, hand sketches drawn into the white page between statements, and a ring of small rotated square team photographs round a centred headline on black; 27 images and a fixed WebGL layer, no video.
references.motion: A white preloader with a progress line along the top and a counter stalled near 60 for 2.5s; by 4.5s the hero is in and the title rises out of a mask line by line. Lenis over the fixed WebGL layer: sketches build stroke by stroke on a scrub, the ground flips white to black over 0.3s at the values chapter, paragraph lines rise over 0.5s, and team photographs spiral in and settle into a ring; one ease for everything, cubic-bezier(.17,.84,.44,1), 34 uses.

references.name: Belgrade Arbor
references.idea: A residential and office complex whose facade branches like a tree canopy, and every device on the site follows from that one image: photographs cut into rounded branch-like shards, forest-green and vanilla grounds, bronze titles and one sprout-lime accent.
references.hero: Built as a full-bleed 1440x900 video scrubbed by scroll under a fixed WebGL canvas, with no poster; in the capture neither painted, so the desktop first screen stayed plain vanilla (#fdfbef) for the whole 4.5s with only a centred dark pill nav about 640x58 at y≈24 (menu left, a small gold tree mark centre, an outlined enquiry pill right). On the phone the fold is a grey pencil drawing of the branch-columned facade filling the screen and fading to white at the bottom, where a 66px name is lost in the wash. The real message, that the facade follows a tree canopy, first appears one screen down as a six-line 56px serif paragraph.
references.type: Two families. A light old-style editorial serif (300 roman and italic, 400) carries every statement and every list at 56px (3.9vw), leading 1.1, tracking +0.02em; uppercase chapter titles run at about 10.5vw and 13vw with leading near 0.9, and one letter-spaced word reaches about 17vw. Work Sans 400/500 does body at 16px, small paragraphs at 14px, and the tracked uppercase labels and buttons. Active list items turn italic.
references.colour: #fdfbef #2e3a26 #a68150 #ccbf99 #fff4d6 #e7fd55 #314759 — Vanilla page with pine-green text and dark grounds; bronze for serif titles on light, sand for caps on dark, cream for text on green. An acid lime covers about 2% of the page (labels, the active tab, links), and one late chapter turns slate blue. The pinned chapter sits on a moss-green gradient, which the house version makes a flat moss field.
references.imagery: Warm, soft architectural renders and photographs (sunlit marble, linen, a stair with a tree, dining and lounge interiors) masked into rounded irregular polygons that echo the canopy, and full-bleed macros of folded cream cloth and teal woven upholstery used as grounds for titles. A line-drawn isometric street map with bronze pins, an aerial render on a small rounded card, and a portrait clip of a man crossing a marble lobby.
references.layout: 64px side gutters. Every section is exactly one viewport tall and the chapters meet edge to edge, each marked by a change of ground (vanilla, moss, full-bleed photograph, vanilla, slate) rather than padding. Most screens are half splits, text 64-690 against media on the right, then mirrored. A 9-viewport sticky stage opens the page, and a floating pill nav sits over the top of each section, where it collides with labels and body text.

sections.description: Pinned for 8100px on moss green. Left column at x=64, about 625px wide: a small lime label, a 56px light serif paragraph of five or six lines, and an outlined pill to explore the building in 3D. Right half: two rounded shard-shaped photo masks, a large one about 410x550 and a small one about 225x285 overlapping its lower-left corner and set about 60px lower; the pictures crossfade inside the same shapes. The next paragraph swaps sides. A 280px progress bar with a counter sits bottom-left.
Same green ground: a two-line uppercase serif headline at about 10.5vw running almost margin to margin, then a 14px paragraph about 320px wide offset to x≈830 below it, and an underlined lime link.

Split. Left, x=64-610: six nearby places stacked as 56px light bronze serif lines about 30px apart. Right 60%: a line-drawn isometric street map with bronze pins and the building as a small gold block with a flag.

An opener of folded cream cloth, full-bleed below a 176px vanilla strip, with one bronze uppercase serif word at about 13vw docked bottom-left 150px above the fold. The next screen splits 50/50: unit types as 56px pine serif links on an 80px pitch, the active one in italic, facing a slider of eleven portrait interior renders with round arrows at mid-height.

steal: Take one shape from the subject's own form and use it as the picture mask throughout: here canopy-like rounded polygons, a large and a small one overlapping opposite the text column, swapping sides with each paragraph.

Make lists the headlines: places, unit types and wings set as 56px light serif lines on an 80px pitch, the active one in the accent colour, each list facing a picture, a map or a slider in the other half.

Give every section exactly one viewport and change the ground colour or the full-bleed picture at each, so the scroll reads as chapters without padding bands; open a chapter with a full-bleed close-up of a material and one uppercase word at about 13vw docked bottom-left, coloured from a tone in that material.
references.media: Pictures carry most screens: the pinned chapter pairs two shard-masked photographs opposite the text, chapter openers are full-bleed material close-ups and looping footage, and later chapters split 50/50 between a serif list and a map, a portrait slider or a portrait clip. Six muted videos, none autoplaying; the 16s hero clip has no poster and never painted on desktop.
references.motion: Lenis drives a 9-viewport sticky stage where the ground turns from vanilla to moss, serif paragraphs blur and rise in word by word (939 split characters) and photographs crossfade inside the shards; caps titles sharpen character by character, and one giant word widens its letter spacing with the scroll. The only observed CSS transition is opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); the rest is script-driven (.65s the commonest stylesheet duration), and the page took 12.2s to load.
